title: Disembodied Machine Learning: On the Illusion of Objectivity in NLP
reasoning: The paper is a conceptual critique centered on the epistemology and ethics of objectivity in NLP and Machine Learning. It utilizes feminist Science and Technology Studies (specifically the work of Donna Haraway) to evaluate the ethical implications of current 'bias-limiting' practices and argues that the pursuit of disembodied objectivity can lead to further social marginalization.
